meta_description: Top Reasons to Book The Atticus:   * About 500 yards to Rosemary Beach* 4 Bikes Included* Multiple Balconies and Private Porch * Coffered Ceilings, Rainhead Showers * Commercial-grade Kitchen and Decorative Fireplace* Snorkel the Grouper Reef-more info
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book The Atticus: * About 500 yards to Rosemary Beach* 4 Bikes Included* Multiple Balconies and Private Porch * Coffered Ceilings, Rainhead Showers * Commercial-grade Kitchen and Decorative Fireplace* Snorkel the Grouper Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Access to Four Pools; Fitness/Racquet Club avail for onsite fee* Walk to shops, restaurants and tasty treats * Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* *The provided amenity pass must be left at departure. If lost or taken, you could be assessed as much as $160.*The Atticus is a spacious 3028sqft, 4 bedroom 4 bath home in Rosemary Beach, just off Hwy 30A. A short walk from beach access and 2 blocks from N. Barrett Square, this stunning home offers a bright, open floor plan with gorgeous furnishings, high ceilings, a commercial-grade chef’s kitchen, and even a private office. With 1 King bed, 2 Queen beds, 2 Twin beds, and a twin bunk nook, this luxurious beach home sleeps 10 guests comfortably. Spend all of your vacation days in the sun and sugar sand beaches and know this home will be waiting for you to unwind at your return. With the beautiful beach being a short walk away, there will be nothing stopping you from spending your vacation days in the cool gulf water and soaking in the sun. After a long day at the beach, relax on the shaded front porch or rinse off the sand in the rain head showers. Come see why friends and families fall in love with The Atticus year after year.Guests staying in Rosemary Beach will enjoy access to all four pools, located strategically in each of the four quadrants of town, more details below. Access to the Rosemary Beach Racquet Club and Fitness Center is available for an additional onsite fee. Beach chair service is available for rent year-round on a first come/first serve basis. Other perks include 2.3 miles of boardwalk and trails that wind through the town with 19 pocket parks and green spaces. Several include playgrounds, on the northwest corner at West Kingston, you will find the butterfly garden and koi pond.Coquina Pool: Near the beach, it's an infinity edge pool presided over by triangular stucco building which includes men's and women's changing rooms. Open daily from 9am to 9pm.Sky Pool: Indoor pool with a retractable roof. The pool deck features radiant heating for the winter months and three swim lanes. Open daily from 6am to 10pm. Adult only hours are 6am-9am and 8pm-10pm.Barbados Pool: Outdoor Pool immediately recognizable by its copper roof and fountain, located on the south west section of Rosemary Beach and features a small children's pool. Open Daily from 9am to 9pm.Cabana Pool: Outdoor pool with Mediterranean design, cabana style dressing rooms and a separate children's pool. A playground for kids adjoins it. Open Daily from 9am to 9pm.Bed Setup: Second Floor: Master Bedroom: King Bed Guest Room: Queen Bed Guest Room: Queen Bed Third Floor: Guest Room: 2 Twin Beds Twin Bunk Nook Area Attractions: You will be enchanted the moment you catch your first glimpse of this seaside town. Named by CNN as one of America's most romantic small towns, Rosemary Beach does not disappoint. Situated on the east end of 30A, the Old World style town center boasts influences from the West Indies, New Orleans and Charleston. You will find cobblestone streets filled with boutique shops, fine and casual dining, a farmer's market and sweet shops to enjoy a hand-made soda or milkshake. Another unique feature is the 2.3 miles of interconnected pathways and boardwalks, illuminated at night by gas lanterns. You will love the picturesque green lawn, sugar white beaches and lovely Emerald waters that make this area so famous. And you will love Rosemary Beach.30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
